item.title: Can I Retire at 62 Before Medicare? What to Model First

item.description: Claiming Social Security at 62 gives income sooner, but waiting can raise monthly benefits. Learn what to model before choosing a claiming age.

item.title: Can I Retire At 55? What To Model Before Leaving Work
item.description: Retiring at 55 means planning for healthcare before Medicare, withdrawals before Social Security, early distribution rules, taxes, inflation, and market risk.
